sanskrit_verse:
सभिकः कारयेद् द्यूतं देयं दद्याच च तत्कृतम् ।
दशकं तु शतं वृद्धिस्तस्य स्याद् द्यूतकारिता ॥
transliteration: sabhikaḥ kārayed dyūtaṃ deyaṃ dadyāc ca tatkṛtam | daśakaṃ tu śataṃ vṛddhis tasya syād dyūtakāritā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The sabhika shall cause gambling to occur, and he shall give what is won thereby; tenfold increase accrues to him through the act of gambling.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the sabhika as the orchestrator of lawful transactional space
Causation arises through conscious facilitation, not passive witnessing
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to the authority of structuring relational-economic fields
Restoration logic demands completion of energetic exchange cycles within dharmic containers
Consciousness alignment occurs through direct assumption of consequence loops
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent holds sabhika-role THEN agent must initiate and complete dyūta-event
IF dyūta-event concludes THEN sabhika must distribute all generated value-equivalents
IF distribution fails THEN liability multiplies at 10x rate until restoration
IF sabhika assumes role THEN capacity for value-multiplication is activated at 10:100 ratio
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, the sabhika bears absolute structural liability for all outcomes within the convened transactional field. No delegation absolves this foundational causality. Responsibility magnifies proportionally when systemic integrity is breached.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that outcome-multiplication follows from intentional initiation. Anupūrvaśaḥ establishes sequential causality: invitation → enactment → consequence assumption. Responsibility aligns with capacity to restore flow. No punitive overlay exists—only completion mechanics.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Sabhika must enter full perceptual replay of transactional sequence
All unallocated value units must be returned to source vectors via conscious acknowledgment
Multiplier debt dissolves upon completion of threefold restitution cycle
Reintegration occurs when sabhika demonstrates stabilized capacity to hold transactional field without leakage
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored through execution of sabhika-liability. Reality operates without punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
